description: Intel VID: L850-GL / L860-GL in the XMM/NCM composition: MODEM + 2 CDC-ACM + 3 CDC-NCM (4PDA 1066668-570), not MBIM, so no netifd-mbim fallback. ModemManager picks PPP on ttyACM there (4PDA 1066668-16498); the engine's own XMM dial (dial below, never run on a modem of ours: status unverified, taken only on the operator's backend 'native'): XGAUTH then CGAUTH, XDNS before CGACT, DNS from XDNS? (CGCONTRDP is empty), AT+XDATACHANNEL and CGDATA M-RAW_IP on ACM2 (interface 4, /USBCDC/2; the port carries data afterwards), the address on the NCM of interface 6 with ARP off, on-link route (another modem manager docs/modems/fibocom.md and other scripts create_connect.sh, behaviour only; both /USBCDC/0 and /USBCDC/2 appear in field logs). AT ttyACM0, SMS ttyACM2 in the historical observations; profiles audit 2026-10-19. Before the first bench run: 4PDA (via another modem manager 3.9.9.x, docs/modem-zoo/RELEASE-DELTA-2026-11-02.md) has the working setups dialling on ttyACM0 with /USBCDC/0, and a dial on ttyACM2 in a 15-40 s disconnect loop; keep the XDATACHANNEL channel and the CGDATA port the same one, and the metrics/SMS port off it
